reasons.correctness: createTicket now publishes SupportTicketCreatedEvent through ApplicationEventPublisher. The listener sends the confirmation with @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT). The interface matches exactly. Build green, hidden tests 3/3, existing tests 54/54.
reasons.convention_fit: The listener uses AFTER_COMMIT and catches and logs failures. @RequiredArgsConstructor injects final fields. The event sits in the feature package support/ticket/event. The service keeps its explicit constructor. New MockitoExtension unit test added, and the service unit test updated for the new constructor.
reasons.design_fit: Mirrors the InvoiceCreatedEvent/Listener pattern it read. Minimal footprint: the service keeps emailService only for addAdminResponse. No duplicated logic and no new mechanism. The integration test's assertion was flipped to never(), which the behaviour change justifies.
reasons.test_quality: The listener unit test covers the send path and the swallowed-exception path. The failure test has no explicit assertion (no assertDoesNotThrow, no verify). The service test checks the published event fields but not the language, and uses verifyNoInteractions(emailService).
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located the support/ticket package and existing *EventListener and event classes before any edit. The agent then read InvoiceCreatedEvent and InvoiceCreatedEventListener as examples and followed their structure.
